propositions: Destructive repair must use a durable, provider-neutral pause ownership mechanism via refs/reconciler/gate instead of GitHub-CLI workflow disable/enable.
Repair sequence must fail-closed: validate git user.email, read durable gate for foreign pauses, generate and CAS-write ownership token, verify lock safety, then execute repair.
Cleanup must read pause+OID as one snapshot, abort if pause reason differs from invocation token, delete only by observed OID, and never recreate or clear another actor's pause.
Both fsck --repair and doctor --repair must use the same repair-owned pause contract without changing their public vocabulary, repair effects, or non-repair behavior.
Missing git email, pre-existing pause, pause creation uncertainty, held/corrupt lock, or lock transport failure must abort repair before destructive mutation.

Multi-environment support must be verified: local, GHA, Jenkins, GitLab, and bare-remote invocations share pause behavior; two-clone contention proves ownership replacement cannot clear another actor's pause.
